parameters.content:
Cron: 毎月 1日 00:10 UTC
- 先月分（YYYY-MM）を集計し `reports/monthly/<YYYY-MM>.md` を MR で反映

Env (expected):
- N8N_GITLAB_API_BASE_URL (or GITLAB_API_BASE_URL)
- N8N_GITLAB_TOKEN (or GITLAB_TOKEN)
- HR_TALENT_GITLAB_PROJECT_PATH (optional; default: <realm>/hr-talent-management)
- HR_TALENT_DEFAULT_BRANCH (optional; default: main)
